description: Create a hyperlink on the first occurrence of sourceText in the document. The destination is a URL, a page, or the first occurrence of some other text (a text anchor).

destination.description: For URL: the URL. For TEXT: existing text in the document to link to. Not used for PAGE.

name.description: Optional hyperlink name (must be unique in the document)

pageIndex.description: Zero-based destination page index (required for PAGE links)

sourceText.description: Existing text in the document to turn into a link (first occurrence, case-sensitive)

name: create_document_hyperlink
title: Create Document Hyperlink
